summary: Phase C (Save + replay captured video) end-to-end testing. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases passed for upload (raw + overlay), validation (invalid variant=400, empty=400, invalid MIME=415, unauth=401, unknown session=404), list, stream with Bearer header AND ?auth=<jwt> query fallback, soft-delete idempotency (re-upload keeps only latest), delete -> 404, reanalyze (200 with analysis+form_score persisted), unknown reanalyze=404, session-delete cascade. Frontend: Capture page renders save-video-toggle/save-video-checkbox below pose canvas (defaults OFF, toggles to ON). SessionDetail renders video-replay-card with session-video-player <video> tag and Re-analyze button enabled when raw video exists. Sessions list regression OK. One frontend test miss: reanalyze button click did not capture a response within 60s in the browser, and delete-video-raw button was not found in DOM at click time (likely below viewport or only rendered after video metadata loads). The backend reanalyze endpoint itself is verified working via pytest.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid="delete-video-raw" button was not present in DOM at the moment we queried it (count=0). The render conditional is `{active && ...}` and `active` should exist when a raw video is available. The button is correctly defined in code (line 795-803) but may not render until <video> metadata loads, or render order may differ. Worth a quick check that `active` is truthy on first paint when videos[].length === 1. Not a blocker — backend DELETE is verified.

Click on [data-testid='reanalyze-btn'] did not produce a captured POST /reanalyze response within 60s in Playwright. Backend endpoint itself works (pytest passes in ~5-15s). Possible causes: (a) the AuthContext axios instance silently retried/swallowed the request, or (b) the button has a debounce/loading state that suppressed re-trigger because Playwright clicked while another in-flight call was pending. Manual click probably works; recommend adding a visible 'Re-analyzing…' state confirmation and surfacing errors via toast.

action_items: (Optional) Verify VideoReplayCard's delete-video-{variant} button is in the DOM immediately when a single variant exists (no race with <video> metadata).
(Optional) Add a loading/disabled state with a 'Re-analyzing…' label on [data-testid='reanalyze-btn'] while the LLM call is in flight, and surface failures via toast.
Pre-existing (from iter 3, not retested): 'Building PDF' spinner never shows, and Landing light-mode hero has low-contrast text.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py upload_session_video: correctly validates variant, MIME, size, soft-deletes prior, stores via emergent obj storage with retry on 403, and persists metadata in MongoDB session_videos collection. _video_public() strips internal fields including _id — good (no ObjectId leak).
auth.get_current_user_id supports ?auth= JWT fallback so <video src> tags work without Authorization headers — clean.
delete_session correctly soft-deletes session_videos when the parent session is hard-deleted (validated by cascade test).
reanalyze_session is idempotent and reuses stored pose_summary — minimal cost, sensible design.
storage.py: graceful 403/retry pattern is good; consider adding exponential backoff for transient 5xx.
SessionDetail.jsx is ~926 lines — getting large. Consider extracting VideoReplayCard, KeyframeCard, PlanView into their own files.
